Psalms 21:6 MSG
You pile blessings on him…

Psalm 21v6 CEV
You have given him blessings that will last forever, and you have made him glad by being so near to him.

??The word PILE reminds me of a pile of bricks…

As kids, we could pile up Lego bricks to the high heavens…
When stuffs are piled, they are usually a beauty to behold.
When we therefore, talk of piling, it’s certain we are talking about more than one layer…
?
Today, God will pile on you loads of blessings..
?????
Amos 9v13-14MSG
“Things are going to happen so fast your head will swim, one thing fast on the heels of the other. You won’t be able to keep up. Everything will be happening at once…

Yes, when the blessings come, you won’t be able to keep up.. You will need extra hands to be able to contain the barrage of blessings. ????

I am fully persuaded that your story will change this week in Jesus name.
